verdict.rationale: Notion documents first-party Custom Agents that run continuously ("Keep work moving 24/7 with agents") and can be managed via the Agent APIs, which suggests autonomous AI work inside the workspace. Nothing shows those agents triaging or prioritizing incoming bugs or tasks. The REST API and webhooks are only developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented AI triage/prioritization of incoming items, automatic triggering of agents on new bugs/tasks, examples of agents setting priority or assignment properties, hands-on or independent corroboration.
